text: Heavy product photos slow your website down. Shrink them free with TinyPNG in three steps. Step one. Open tinypng dot com. You don't need an account. Step two. Drop in your photos. You can add up to twenty, five megabytes each. Step three. Wait a few seconds. Then download them one by one, or all at once as a ZIP. Your pixels and dimensions stay the same. TinyPNG says JPG files usually come out more than sixty percent smaller. Lighter photos help your pages load faster on your customers' phones. Now the limits. The free plan caps you at twenty images per session and five megabytes per file, and it shows ads. Folder uploads need the paid Web Ultra plan. Web Pro costs thirty nine US dollars a year for unlimited compressions. Send this to someone who runs a business. And follow Vaelolab for free tools that save you time.
